item.title: Herbert Blomstedt, renowned conductor with a seven-decade career, dies aged 99
item.description: The much loved Swedish-American musician, particularly known for his work with the San Francisco Symphony and Leipzig Gewandhaus, continued performing until earlier this year The conductor Herbert Blomstedt has died aged 99. His career stretched over an extraordinary seven decades and he continued to conduct and tour into his late 90s; his final concert was earlier this year, aged 98. Born in Massachusetts, US, in July 1927 to Swedish parents, the musician grew up in Sweden and Finland. His conducting tutors included Igor Markevitch, Jean Morel and Leonard Bernstein. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
item.dc:creator: Imogen Tilden

item.description: The cult Italian film-maker began as an assistant to Roberto Rossellini but moved into sex films, believing ‘eroticism to be a fundamental key to human expression’ Italian film director Tinto Brass, who was once hailed as the “Antonioni of the 70s” but came to be better known for bringing Italian erotic cinema to a wider audience with films such as Caligula and Salon Kitty, has died aged 93. His wife Caterina Varzi and children Bonifacio and Beatrice Brass announced the news of the director’s death to Italian press agency Ansa on Wednesday. Continue reading... item.title: ASÍ FUE EL CHOQUE DE TRENES QUE CONMOCIONÓ A ESPAÑA Una reconstrucción realizada con inteligencia artificial recrea el impacto entre dos trenes de alta velocidad en Urda, Toledo, que dejó 69 muertos y alrededor de 200 heridos. A seis días de la tragedia, la investigación busca determinar cómo una falla en el sistema de seguridad ferroviaria y una serie de órdenes desde el centro de control permitieron que un tren AVE de Renfe impactara contra una formación de Iryo que permanecía detenida sobre las vías. En medio de las repercusiones políticas, el ministro de Transportes español, Óscar Puente, anunció su renuncia durante una comparecencia en el Congreso. Además, el Gobierno aprobó un paquete de 30 millones de euros en ayudas para las víctimas y sus familiares. | LA NACION

item.title: ‘The Cat in the Hat’ Review: Bill Hader Leads an Animated Dr. Seuss Comedy So Overstuffed It’s Like a Marvel Movie for Tots
item.description: The new "Cat in the Hat," it goes without saying at this point, makes no attempt to be a faithful adaptation of Dr. Seuss’s most fabled books. That would simply be too quaint for our buzzy, mercurial, attention-crashing, video-games-on-Ritalin era. Yet even as the movie departs all too eagerly from the innocent wildness of the Seuss books, it devotes itself, with a corporate diligence that’s the opposite of free-spirited, to mimicking the scale and spirit and plot setups of too many familiar blockbusters. It’s a mish-mosh of pop recycling. Fuente: Variety.
